items.name: Stable Audio 3.0
items.why: 支援長達 6 分 20 秒的音樂和音效生成，提供開放權重模型及音訊修復功能。
items.why_en: Supports music and sound effect generation up to 6 minutes 20 seconds, offers open-weight models and audio inpainting.

items.name: Gemini 3.1 Flash TTS
items.why: 具備 200+ 音訊標籤、70+ 語言支援及 SynthID 浮水印，在 TTS 評比中表現優異。
items.why_en: Features 200+ audio tags, 70+ language support, SynthID watermarking, and excels in TTS benchmarks.

items.name: MAI-Voice-1
items.why: 能在一秒內生成 60 秒音訊，並可從數秒樣本創建自訂語音。
items.why_en: Capable of generating 60 seconds of audio in 1 second and creating custom voices from a few seconds of samples.

items.name: Suno Studio (進階音軌分離功能)

items.why_en: Offers advanced stem separation with nearly 100 instrument options, significantly enhancing fine control for sound design.

items.name: Microsoft Copilot Cowork (GA)
items.why: Copilot Cowork正式發佈，提供多工具、長任務的代理能力，並整合M365生態系統，實現企業級AI自動化。
items.why_en: Copilot Cowork officially launched, offering multi-tool, long-running agentic capabilities integrated within the M365 ecosystem for enterprise-grade AI automation.

items.name: n8n AI Agent Node with Multi-Model Tool Calling
items.why: n8n的AI Agent節點重構，支援Claude、GPT-4o、Gemini 1.5 Pro等多模型工具呼叫，大幅提升複雜AI工作流的自動化能力。
items.why_en: n8n's rebuilt AI Agent node supports multi-model tool calling across Claude, GPT-4o, Gemini 1.5 Pro, and more, significantly enhancing complex AI workflow automation.

items.name: Anthropic Claude Managed Agents (Public Beta)
items.why: Claude Managed Agents推出公開測試版，支援排程運行、安全存取CLI工具和認證服務，實現自動化、重複性的AI任務。
items.why_en: Claude Managed Agents launched public beta, supporting scheduled runs, secure access to CLI tools and authenticated services, enabling automated, recurring AI tasks.

items.name: ElevenLabs Music v2 API
items.why: ElevenLabs Music v2 API發佈，引入基於區塊的作曲計畫，提供對音樂結構、節奏和編曲更精細的控制，強化多模態內容創作。
items.why_en: ElevenLabs Music v2 API launched, introducing chunk-based composition plans for finer control over music structure, pacing, and arrangement, enhancing multimodal content creation.

items.name: Raycast AI v2 Personalization & Dictation
items.why: Raycast AI v2新增個人化設定（Profile, Memory）和系統級聽寫功能，讓AI助理更具上下文感知能力並提升輸入效率。
items.why_en: Raycast AI v2 adds personalization (Profile, Memory) and system-wide dictation, making the AI assistant more context-aware and improving input efficiency.

items.name: GitHub Copilot Enterprise with Custom Knowledge Bases
items.why: GitHub Copilot Enterprise深度整合組織內部知識庫，提供基於專有文檔和代碼模式的AI建議，加速開發者入職與效率。
items.why_en: GitHub Copilot Enterprise deeply integrates with internal knowledge bases, offering AI suggestions grounded in proprietary documentation and code patterns, accelerating developer onboarding and efficiency.

items.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot GitHub Server Knowledge Connector
items.why: 新的連接器將GitHub Enterprise Server知識庫整合到Microsoft 365 Copilot中，讓用戶能在M365應用中直接查詢GitHub文檔。
items.why_en: New connector integrates GitHub Enterprise Server knowledge bases into Microsoft 365 Copilot, allowing users to query GitHub documentation directly within M365 apps.

items.name: Obsidian Obsilo Agent Plugin
items.why: Obsilo Agent插件讓Obsidian更像一個代理平台，支援工具、記憶、MCP和任務執行，將筆記本轉化為強大的AI工作區。
items.why_en: The Obsilo Agent plugin transforms Obsidian into an agent platform, supporting tools, memory, MCP, and task execution, turning the notebook into a powerful AI workspace.

items.name: Microsoft Foundry Hosted Agents GA
items.why: Microsoft Foundry的託管代理服務正式發佈，提供生產級代理的受管運行時，支援多框架和端到端追蹤與評估。
items.why_en: Microsoft Foundry's Hosted Agents service reached GA, providing a managed runtime for production agents with multi-framework support and end-to-end tracing and evaluation.

items.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot Planner Agent (GA)
items.why: Microsoft 365 Copilot中的Planner代理正式發佈，允許用戶直接在Copilot內創建、更新和管理個人任務與共享計劃。
items.why_en: The Planner agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot reached GA, allowing users to create, update, and manage personal tasks and shared plans directly within Copilot.
